paragraphs.text: This policy explains how LAMID ONE collects, uses, shares, retains, and protects personal information.
Personal information may come from your account, service use, workspaces, uploads, connected sources, and other interactions covered by this policy.
Personal information is processed for purposes described in this policy, including service delivery, security, support, permitted improvement, and applicable legal obligations.
This policy also covers relevant security practices, policy changes, and how to contact LAMID ONE about privacy.
